sources.title: SOF International Science Olympiad (ISO) Syllabus Class 2
sources.notes: Official SOF page. Current Class 2 science scope includes Plants, Animals, Human Body, Food, Housing and Clothing, Family and Festivals, Good Habits and Safety Rules, Transport and Communication, Air, Water and Rocks, and Earth and Universe, plus logical reasoning and higher-order questions.

sources.title: Class 2 International Science Olympiad Workbook
sources.notes: Official SOF catalog page identifies the workbook as the 2026-27 edition and lists the current Class 2 ISO chapter structure.

sources.title: SOF International Science Olympiad Class 2 Sample Paper 2026-27
sources.notes: Official SOF sample paper confirms 35 questions: 5 Logical Reasoning at 1 mark each, 25 Science at 1 mark each, and 5 Achievers at 2 marks each, for 40 marks total. It also demonstrates mixed formats including statement evaluation, visual questions, word manipulation and higher-order inference. It supports assessment-format design, not exact row-level curriculum placement.
